description:
Hushfacebook v0.19.0 targets Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This one has 105 patches and needs Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer, so update Manager first. Posts can get Save and Download buttons under them, and new switches take Like, Comment, Share or Send off posts and reels, hide posts from Pages or drop the dislike on comments. Feed videos can get a cast button, downloads can go to an SD card, and 32-bit phones are supported now.

Validation: 3928 runtime tests passed locally. All 1204 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 105 patches applied to Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, build 475817393, or its 32-bit build 475817404. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Added

* **Facebook:** New `Badge and logo colors` lets you pick your own color for the red count badges on the tabs and for the blue Facebook logo at the top of Home. Type a color code like #2ECC71 in `Badge color` or `Logo color` under Appearance and restart Facebook. Left blank, both keep Facebook's colors, and settings backups carry them (Refs #263).
* **Facebook:** Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 now works on 32-bit phones too. The armeabi-v7a Android 11+ bundle, build 475817404, is declared next to the arm64 build 475817393, and every patch applies to it. Contributed by toidicakhia (Refs #254).
* **Facebook:** `Hide the Create button` under Tabs and navigation takes the + button for new posts, reels and stories out of the top bar, on both versions of the bar Facebook hands out. It starts off and shows after a restart (Refs #257).
* **Facebook:** A reel's More menu has `Copy caption` now. It copies the whole caption, including the part hidden behind See more, so there's no more screenshotting a long caption to get its text. It's on by default, and `Copy reel captions` under Reels and Watch turns it off (Refs #240).
* **Facebook:** You can pick a plain home screen icon when you patch. The `Icon style` option of Hushfacebook settings in Morphe draws Facebook's "f" white on black or black on white, and `Facebook colors` (the default) leaves the icon alone. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work with either one (Refs #278).
* **Facebook:** New `Show full post text` puts a long post's whole text in the feed, so there's no See more to tap. It starts off. Turn it on under News feed in Hushfacebook's settings, and the diagnostic report counts each post it kept whole (Refs #268).
* **Facebook:** Downloads can go to an SD card. Pick it in `Save on`, right above `Save to` under Downloads, and videos and photos land on the card in the same folders they'd use on the phone. The phone's storage stays the default. If the card is out of the phone, saves go to the phone's storage until you put it back, so a save never fails over a missing card (Refs #274).
* **Facebook:** Reels can pause while you read their comments. Turn on `Pause reels while comments are open` under Comments and writing, and a playing reel stops when its comments open and picks up from the same spot when you close them. A reel you start yourself under the comments keeps playing (Refs #266).
* **Facebook:** `Words to hide` and `Words that keep a post` have a test box under the list now. Paste a post's text and it says whether that post would hide or stay, and which list decided, using the list as you've typed it so far, before you tap Save. Nothing you paste gets saved, and only its first 16,384 characters are checked.
* **Facebook:** `Newest reels first` is called `Sort loaded reels` now, and a `Reels order` row right under it picks how: `Newest` (the old behavior and still the default) or `Most liked`. It still only reorders the reels Facebook has already loaded for you. A reel without the count it's sorted by keeps Facebook's spot for it. Search finds the switch by its old name too, and settings backups carry the order (Refs #134).
* **Facebook:** Feed videos can get a cast button. Facebook took its own casting out, so `Cast button on feed videos` under Video and audio puts a button in the video's top right corner that hands it to a casting app you already have, like Web Video Caster, and that app sends it to your TV. It starts off and needs a build with the video download patch. If the video hasn't loaded a file yet, it says so and asks you to play it for a moment first (Refs #182).
* **Facebook:** Posts can have Save and Download buttons under them now, next to Like, Comment and Share. `Save button under posts` adds Facebook's own Save button, filled bookmark and all. `Download button under posts` adds a Download button to posts with a video or photos, and it saves them the same way the post's menu does (an album saves every photo). Both are under News feed and start off. Download needs a build with the video or photo download patch, and posts with nothing to save don't get the button. Right below them, `Hide Like under posts`, `Hide Comment under posts`, `Hide Share under posts` and `Hide Send under posts` each take one button out of that row in the feed. Reels get the same under Reels and Watch: `Hide Like on reels`, `Hide Comment on reels` and `Hide Share on reels` take that button off the side of a reel, next to the Save and WhatsApp switches that were already there (Refs #151, Refs #265).
* **Facebook:** `Hide dislike on comments` under Comments and writing takes the thumbs-down off comments, the one Facebook puts next to Like on reels and videos. Like and Reply stay. It starts off (Refs #241).
* **Facebook:** `Hide posts from Pages` under News feed takes posts written by Pages out of the feed, the Pages you follow included. Friends' and group posts stay, and so does a friend's share of a Page's post. It starts off (Refs #262).

### Changed

* **Facebook:** You need Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer now. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.0.1, which uses less memory while patching, and older Managers refuse a bundle built on it, so update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 1.19.1 or newer.
* **Facebook:** Hush titles are drawn in Facebook's blues now, shifting slowly with a light sheen moving across. That covers the settings bar and search, Hush dialogs, the screen shown when settings can't open, and the lock cover. Every color stays readable on its background in every theme, and the titles keep moving even with Android's animations off.
* **Facebook:** Long sections are easier to scan. News feed, Reels and Watch, Video and audio, Appearance and Pause, backup and diagnostics group their rows under small headings like `Content filters`, `Video quality` and `Troubleshooting`, still right on the main page. Where the tab bar sits, what it does while you scroll, which tabs hide and their dots all moved to a new Tabs and navigation section. `Tab bar position` and `Tab bar while scrolling` are each one pick from three now, with Facebook's own behavior first, so the two old switches can't fight each other.
* **Facebook:** A few names got clearer. Playback is Video and audio, Links is Links and sharing, Chats is Chats and Messenger, and Set when you patched is Built-in changes. Writing joined Comments, and the quality row reads `Default quality`. Search still finds everything by its old name. `Save crashes to Downloads` moved from Privacy to Troubleshooting, right above Pause, and Support keeps help and restart apart from supporting the project.
* **Facebook:** `Hide posts with words you choose` now reads a shared link's headline and the line under it too, so a news post whose only mention of a word is in its link preview hides. That includes the newer cards Facebook draws from its own layout, where the headline isn't a plain field. A keep word on the preview still keeps the post (Refs #255).
* **Facebook:** The `Only from a reel's More menu` description says which reels get the Picture-in-picture row. Upright reels do, wide ones never did, and the old wording made a missing row look like a bug (Refs #252).
* **Facebook:** Patching with `Material You theme` on is faster. Its scans now skip the parts of Facebook they can't change, and the patched app comes out the same as before (Refs #236).
* **Facebook:** The README now explains how to go back to an earlier release that lists your Facebook version. You add its bundle as a local source in Manager, patch with the same key and install over your copy. Sign-in and settings stay, and the README lists what `Export settings` leaves out. The steps follow Manager 2.2's own screens and cover what to do when Manager reports a Package conflict instead of installing.
* **Facebook:** `Accent color` works with the Material You theme now. It used to sit greyed out whenever Material You was patched in. Now the color you pick replaces your wallpaper's accent and the wallpaper's greys stay, while the first choice, `Wallpaper accent`, keeps the phone's own. It's picked in Hushfacebook's settings under Appearance with no repatch, and Facebook picks it up after a restart (Refs #272).

### Fixed

* **Facebook:** With `See-through bars` on, a blurred strip no longer hangs above the bottom tab bar while it slides away or comes back. The blur used to spread past the bar's edge whenever the bar was partly faded (Refs #250, #124).
* **Facebook:** With `Picture-in-picture` off, reels no longer shrink into a floating window when you leave Facebook. Some accounts get Facebook's own version of that window, switched on from Facebook's side or from its Media settings, and it used to slip past the switch (Refs #252, #256).
* **Facebook:** With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a regular video post in your feed (one that isn't a reel) starts as fast as it does with the switch off. That now includes video posts you open from inside a group. Their full screen viewer used to sit on a blank loading screen first, for up to a second on the home feed and two seconds or more in a group. Reels you open from the feed still play alone with nothing after them (Refs #237).
* **Tooling:** A device walk no longer fails a page because something an earlier step left open is sitting on top of it. On the S22 the long press on a reel left a comment sheet over the next page, and the Notifications step failed on two walks in a row. When a page can't be confirmed, the walk now presses Back once and opens the link again. Checked in the audit's tests.
* **Tooling:** The device walk reads the phone's screen text as UTF-8. Started from Git Bash, it read it in the console's old code page, so the curly apostrophe in a notification's settings button never matched and the Notifications step failed on a page that was right there. Checked in the audit's tests.
* **Facebook:** With `Tap to play` on, a video you open from a comment plays in Facebook's full screen player again. It used to sit paused there until you left Facebook and came back (Refs #242).
* **Tooling:** Device audits read their settings snapshots in Windows PowerShell too, so the push check no longer fails every restore case where git can't find pwsh.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reads the Morphe Patch Tracker in Windows PowerShell too. The tracker now lists two bundles whose names differ only by capital letters, and when git couldn't find pwsh the push check stopped on it.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Light background color there gives light mode a soft color in place of white. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

options.description: The color dark mode's backgrounds use, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117. Leave it blank for black. Cards and inputs get a slightly lighter shade. Grays up to about #535353 work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Badge and logo colors
patches.description: Paints the count badges on the tabs, the Facebook logo at the top of Home and the selected tab in colors you pick. Nothing changes until you type a color. Set them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops the jobs Facebook runs in the background to download ads, and the model it ranks them with, before you ever see them. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Block screenshot detection
patches.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Clean up Facebook's chat list
patches.description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. A third takes the Meta AI button off the search row and the search screen. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Comment sheet options
patches.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide the comments under feed posts or the thumbs-down on comments, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, hide the emoji row over the comment box, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest, All comments or Oldest, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Don't save search history
patches.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched, so it learns less about what you watch. Reels you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Double tap to skip
patches.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Download any photo
patches.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. The More menu also gets Copy caption, which copies the reel's whole caption. On by default. Turn either off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Following feed on Home
patches.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Frame step
patches.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. Switches there, off by default, also hide the Meta AI shortcut or the whole Help and support section and keep Settings and privacy open, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Three more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide counts on posts and Hide the reaction preview on posts, start off.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts, or every post a Page wrote, can go too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide profile notes
patches.description: Hides the note bubble on profile pictures, the Drop a thought prompt on your own profile included. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide seen posts
patches.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide tab badges
patches.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch, and a third keeps the plain 2x pill without Facebook's "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Home header text
patches.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon, and Icon style can make the icon white on black or black on white. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

options.description: A name to show under the app icon, in App info and in recent apps instead of Facebook, up to 50 characters, so this copy is easy to tell apart. Leave it empty to keep Facebook's name. It only changes the name. Clone app is what lets a copy install next to the official Facebook.
Facebook colors keeps the home screen icon as it is. White on black and Black on white draw Facebook's "f" in one color on a plain icon. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep post dates
patches.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Keep the progress bar
patches.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Longer music on photo stories
patches.description: A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Newest reels first
patches.description: Plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first in the Reels tab, instead of Facebook's own pick. It can't fetch newer reels. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates.

patches.name: Open comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up, on posts, videos, reels and stories. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. A second switch pauses a reel while its comments are open. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. It also lets a long press on a post's text open that text to select part of it, a switch in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom
patches.description: Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in, like you can on photos in the feed. It goes back when you let go, unless you turn on Stay zoomed under it, which keeps the zoom until you tap or press Back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Post action buttons
patches.description: Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts, and a Download button on posts with a video or photos that saves them the way the post's menu does. It can also take Like, Comment, Share or Send out of that row. Each has its own switch, and they all start off. Find them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, and lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing.

patches.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Share sheet items
patches.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Show full post text
patches.description: Shows all of a post's text in the feed, so you don't have to tap See more. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Skip silent parts
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. `Tab bar position` can also put it at the top, as older Facebook had it, or leave it where Facebook puts it. `Tab bar while scrolling` lets it slide away as you scroll or keeps it on screen, and another switch keeps the top bar on screen. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Pick it in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook. The see-through and status bar switches sit under Appearance.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Tap shows the controls
patches.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. A separate switch adds a play/pause button to feed videos. The switches start off in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches.description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or video from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

release_notes:
This one needs Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer, so update Manager before you patch. Posts can get Save and Download buttons under them, and new switches take Like, Comment, Share or Send off posts and reels, hide posts from Pages or drop the dislike on comments. Feed videos can get a cast button, downloads can go to an SD card, and 32-bit phones work now. You can also pick your own badge and logo colors, sort reels by most liked and copy a reel's whole caption.

New in this release

- New `Badge and logo colors` lets you pick your own color for the red count badges on the tabs and for the blue Facebook logo at the top of Home. Type a color code like #2ECC71 in `Badge color` or `Logo color` under Appearance and restart Facebook. Left blank, both keep Facebook's colors, and settings backups carry them (Refs #263).

- Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 now works on 32-bit phones too. The armeabi-v7a Android 11+ bundle, build 475817404, is declared next to the arm64 build 475817393, and every patch applies to it. Contributed by toidicakhia (Refs #254).

- `Hide the Create button` under Tabs and navigation takes the + button for new posts, reels and stories out of the top bar, on both versions of the bar Facebook hands out. It starts off and shows after a restart (Refs #257).

- A reel's More menu has `Copy caption` now. It copies the whole caption, including the part hidden behind See more, so there's no more screenshotting a long caption to get its text. It's on by default, and `Copy reel captions` under Reels and Watch turns it off (Refs #240).

- You can pick a plain home screen icon when you patch. The `Icon style` option of Hushfacebook settings in Morphe draws Facebook's "f" white on black or black on white, and `Facebook colors` (the default) leaves the icon alone. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work with either one (Refs #278).

- New `Show full post text` puts a long post's whole text in the feed, so there's no See more to tap. It starts off. Turn it on under News feed in Hushfacebook's settings, and the diagnostic report counts each post it kept whole (Refs #268).

- Downloads can go to an SD card. Pick it in `Save on`, right above `Save to` under Downloads, and videos and photos land on the card in the same folders they'd use on the phone. The phone's storage stays the default. If the card is out of the phone, saves go to the phone's storage until you put it back, so a save never fails over a missing card (Refs #274).

- Reels can pause while you read their comments. Turn on `Pause reels while comments are open` under Comments and writing, and a playing reel stops when its comments open and picks up from the same spot when you close them. A reel you start yourself under the comments keeps playing (Refs #266).

- `Words to hide` and `Words that keep a post` have a test box under the list now. Paste a post's text and it says whether that post would hide or stay, and which list decided, using the list as you've typed it so far, before you tap Save. Nothing you paste gets saved, and only its first 16,384 characters are checked.

- `Newest reels first` is called `Sort loaded reels` now, and a `Reels order` row right under it picks how: `Newest` (the old behavior and still the default) or `Most liked`. It still only reorders the reels Facebook has already loaded for you. A reel without the count it's sorted by keeps Facebook's spot for it. Search finds the switch by its old name too, and settings backups carry the order (Refs #134).

- Feed videos can get a cast button. Facebook took its own casting out, so `Cast button on feed videos` under Video and audio puts a button in the video's top right corner that hands it to a casting app you already have, like Web Video Caster, and that app sends it to your TV. It starts off and needs a build with the video download patch. If the video hasn't loaded a file yet, it says so and asks you to play it for a moment first (Refs #182).

- Posts can have Save and Download buttons under them now, next to Like, Comment and Share. `Save button under posts` adds Facebook's own Save button, filled bookmark and all. `Download button under posts` adds a Download button to posts with a video or photos, and it saves them the same way the post's menu does (an album saves every photo). Both are under News feed and start off. Download needs a build with the video or photo download patch, and posts with nothing to save don't get the button. Right below them, `Hide Like under posts`, `Hide Comment under posts`, `Hide Share under posts` and `Hide Send under posts` each take one button out of that row in the feed. Reels get the same under Reels and Watch: `Hide Like on reels`, `Hide Comment on reels` and `Hide Share on reels` take that button off the side of a reel, next to the Save and WhatsApp switches that were already there (Refs #151, Refs #265).

- `Hide dislike on comments` under Comments and writing takes the thumbs-down off comments, the one Facebook puts next to Like on reels and videos. Like and Reply stay. It starts off (Refs #241).

- `Hide posts from Pages` under News feed takes posts written by Pages out of the feed, the Pages you follow included. Friends' and group posts stay, and so does a friend's share of a Page's post. It starts off (Refs #262).

Fixes

- With `See-through bars` on, a blurred strip no longer hangs above the bottom tab bar while it slides away or comes back. The blur used to spread past the bar's edge whenever the bar was partly faded (Refs #250, #124).

- With `Picture-in-picture` off, reels no longer shrink into a floating window when you leave Facebook. Some accounts get Facebook's own version of that window, switched on from Facebook's side or from its Media settings, and it used to slip past the switch (Refs #252, #256).

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a regular video post in your feed (one that isn't a reel) starts as fast as it does with the switch off. That now includes video posts you open from inside a group. Their full screen viewer used to sit on a blank loading screen first, for up to a second on the home feed and two seconds or more in a group. Reels you open from the feed still play alone with nothing after them (Refs #237).

- With `Tap to play` on, a video you open from a comment plays in Facebook's full screen player again. It used to sit paused there until you left Facebook and came back (Refs #242).

Other changes

- You need Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer now. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.0.1, which uses less memory while patching, and older Managers refuse a bundle built on it, so update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 1.19.1 or newer.

- Hush titles are drawn in Facebook's blues now, shifting slowly with a light sheen moving across. That covers the settings bar and search, Hush dialogs, the screen shown when settings can't open, and the lock cover. Every color stays readable on its background in every theme, and the titles keep moving even with Android's animations off.

- Long sections are easier to scan. News feed, Reels and Watch, Video and audio, Appearance and Pause, backup and diagnostics group their rows under small headings like `Content filters`, `Video quality` and `Troubleshooting`, still right on the main page. Where the tab bar sits, what it does while you scroll, which tabs hide and their dots all moved to a new Tabs and navigation section. `Tab bar position` and `Tab bar while scrolling` are each one pick from three now, with Facebook's own behavior first, so the two old switches can't fight each other.

- A few names got clearer. Playback is Video and audio, Links is Links and sharing, Chats is Chats and Messenger, and Set when you patched is Built-in changes. Writing joined Comments, and the quality row reads `Default quality`. Search still finds everything by its old name. `Save crashes to Downloads` moved from Privacy to Troubleshooting, right above Pause, and Support keeps help and restart apart from supporting the project.

- `Hide posts with words you choose` now reads a shared link's headline and the line under it too, so a news post whose only mention of a word is in its link preview hides. That includes the newer cards Facebook draws from its own layout, where the headline isn't a plain field. A keep word on the preview still keeps the post (Refs #255).

- The `Only from a reel's More menu` description says which reels get the Picture-in-picture row. Upright reels do, wide ones never did, and the old wording made a missing row look like a bug (Refs #252).

- Patching with `Material You theme` on is faster. Its scans now skip the parts of Facebook they can't change, and the patched app comes out the same as before (Refs #236).

- The README now explains how to go back to an earlier release that lists your Facebook version. You add its bundle as a local source in Manager, patch with the same key and install over your copy. Sign-in and settings stay, and the README lists what `Export settings` leaves out. The steps follow Manager 2.2's own screens and cover what to do when Manager reports a Package conflict instead of installing.

- `Accent color` works with the Material You theme now. It used to sit greyed out whenever Material You was patched in. Now the color you pick replaces your wallpaper's accent and the wallpaper's greys stay, while the first choice, `Wallpaper accent`, keeps the phone's own. It's picked in Hushfacebook's settings under Appearance with no repatch, and Facebook picks it up after a restart (Refs #272).

Behind the scenes

- A device walk no longer fails a page because something an earlier step left open is sitting on top of it. On the S22 the long press on a reel left a comment sheet over the next page, and the Notifications step failed on two walks in a row. When a page can't be confirmed, the walk now presses Back once and opens the link again. Checked in the audit's tests.

- The device walk reads the phone's screen text as UTF-8. Started from Git Bash, it read it in the console's old code page, so the curly apostrophe in a notification's settings button never matched and the Notifications step failed on a page that was right there. Checked in the audit's tests.

- Device audits read their settings snapshots in Windows PowerShell too, so the push check no longer fails every restore case where git can't find pwsh.

- The source audit reads the Morphe Patch Tracker in Windows PowerShell too. The tracker now lists two bundles whose names differ only by capital letters, and when git couldn't find pwsh the push check stopped on it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.2.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `584.0.0.51.56`. On most phones that's build `475817393`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475817404`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 3928 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 105 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, both the 64-bit and the 32-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry (820 entries). I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on an emulator signed in to a full account. 79 of 106 hook families ran there, `Hide the Create button`, `Tap to play` and `Don't save search history` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time, and the 32-bit build was checked by its patch tests rather than on a device.
repoDescription: Hushfacebook Morphe patches for Facebook. Hide ads, suggested posts, save videos and photos, tune playback and Reels, and use a focused Marketplace mode, and much more.
